messages:
daniel: Heads-up — NorthBridge AR called, invoice `NB-2025-079` is 58 days past due. Amount: $48,200. CC on file got declined today. They asked if we can do a 3-month payment plan (3 payments of ~$16k). Can finance advise?

billing-bot: Reminder sent to northbridge-ar@northbridge.com for invoice `NB-2025-079` (due 2025-01-15). Retry attempt on card failed (declined).

maria: thanks @daniel. Quick Q: is there a PO on file or a contract clause we should reference for collections?

daniel: there's an SOW signed (Contract ID `RW-CR-448`) — payment terms were Net30 but account exec says customer had cash-flow issues after round closed later than expected.

sara: ok. Two options IMO: 1) formal 3-month installment plan with signed amendment and ACH mandate, or 2) one-time 30% partial payment now + 60 days to settle balance. We should pick one and present to AR.

jordan: +1 to formal installment. Need to confirm credit hold/feature access pause policy — do we want to suspend Dedicated endpoints if they don't hit the first installment?

maria: prefer not to cut them off immediately if they're cooperating. Recommend payment plan + soft credit hold clause: access limits if payment missed by 7 days. We can escalate to Legal for a one-page amendment.

daniel: customer asked for immediate confirmation so they can set up approvals internally. Can we get a draft amendment today?

sara: I can draft a simple schedule: payment dates = 30/60/90 days from today, ACH/CC mandate, late fee waived for first missed payment if they re-pay within 7 days. Will add clause about access throttling after 7-day grace.

maria: will review draft. Also need sign-off from Revenue Ops for billing schedule and from Legal for amendment language. @jordan can you confirm the throttle settings we can apply without manual ops?

jordan: yes — we can apply a per-customer rate limit tier automatically via the console. I'll provide the exact config snippet for the amendment:

```
throttle_policy: reduced_to_50_percent
action_on_miss: notify + automatic throttling after 7d
```

maria: perfect. Sara, once you have the draft tag me and I'll loop in Revenue Ops + Legal. Daniel, please tell NorthBridge we'll get back within 6 business hours with a draft.

daniel: told them we'll reply today. they appreciated the quick response :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Note: if we set a 3-installment schedule, please create invoice schedule in accounting system (AR-Plan) to avoid duplicate dunning.

sara: will create AR-Plan after sign-off. Drafting now, will ping in ~2h.

maria: thanks. If Legal insists on a different cadence, we'll fall back to 30/60 + 30% upfront. Keep me posted.
